name: Gauntlet
identity: Magistrates of the natural order and living weapons who turn their bodies into fists of the elements. Important Attributes: Perception, Strength, Willpower. Standalone Discipline (not a magician Discipline). Aliases/Variants: Standalone Discipline.
progression:
First Circle (Novice):  Durability 7; Discipline Talents: Avoid Blow, Body Control, Thread Weaving (Gauntlet Weaving), Unarmed Combat, Wound Balance; Talent Options: Awareness, Battle Shout, Danger Sense, Etiquette, Fireblood, Item History, Maneuver, Mystic Pursuit, Wilderness Survival, Wood Skin.
Second Circle:  +1 Physical Defense; Discipline Talent: Deliberate Assault.
Third Circle:  Karma: Spend Karma Point on Recovery test; Discipline Talent: Steel Thought.
Fourth Circle:  +1 Mystic Defense; Discipline Talent: Studied Counter.
Journeyman Talent Options (Circles 5-8):  Astral Sight, Cold Purify, Evidence Analysis, Fire Heal, Iron Constitution, Lion Heart, Resist Taunt, Spot Armor Flaw, Steely Stare, Waterfall Slam.
Fifth Circle (Journeyman):  Elemental Stance (1 Strain for +2 to unarmed Attack, unarmed Damage, Physical Armor, or Mystic Armor; max 1 attack/round); Karma: Spend Karma Point on unarmed Damage test; Discipline Talent: Earth Skin.
Sixth Circle:  +2 Physical Defense; Discipline Talent: Temper Flesh.
Seventh Circle:  +1 Recovery Test per day; Discipline Talent: Crushing Blow.
Eighth Circle:  +2 Mystic Defense; Discipline Talent: Focused Strike.
Warden Talent Options (Circles 9-12):  Blood Share, Burning Vigor, Defensive Posture, Life Check, Lion Spirit, Matrix Sight, Relentless Recovery, Resist Pain, Vine Armor, Vital Strike.
Ninth Circle (Warden):  Pattern Infusion (8-hour ritual, 1 Blood Magic Damage for +3 unarmed Damage or +3 Physical Armor); Karma: Spend Karma Point on active defense test; Discipline Talent: Critical Hit.
Tenth Circle:  +3 Physical Defense, +1 Mystic Armor; Discipline Talent: Unflinching Fortitude.
Eleventh Circle:  +1 Social Defense; Karma: Spend Karma Point on unarmed Attack test (1/round); Discipline Talent: Spirit Strike.
Twelfth Circle:  +3 Mystic Defense, +2 Recovery Tests per day; Discipline Talent: Patient Resilience.
Master Talent Options (Circles 13-15):  Aura Armor, Champion Challenge, Chilling Strike, Elemental Walk, Ethereal Weapon, Second Chance, Soul Aegis, Vital Ward.
Thirteenth Circle (Master):  Pattern Manifestation (Simple action, 4 Strain, attacks gain elemental keyword, +3 unarmed Attack, unarmed Damage, Physical Armor, Mystic Armor); +4 Physical Defense, Karma Step d8, +1 Base Initiative Step; Discipline Talent: Stone Skin.
Fourteenth Circle:  +4 Mystic Defense, +2 Mystic Armor; Discipline Talent: Vicious Wound.
Fifteenth Circle:  +2 Social Defense, +3 Recovery Tests per day; Discipline Talent: Shatter Will.
advancement:
Initial Talent Ranks:  Novice discipline talents start at rank 1.
Circle Advancement Requirements:  Increase required discipline talents and options to match Circle rank.
Half-Magic:  Knowledge of elements, unarmed fighting techniques, prominent unarmed combatants/styles; resist fatigue, distractions, and willpower/endurance tests.
Karma Ritual:  Sit/kneel in contact with earth or stone, extend senses for 30 minutes, then strike and destroy a leaping shard of stone/earth with a single fluid motion.
Discipline Restrictions:  Requires bare hands free for Body Control (no holding weapons or shields). Terrene sense can cause distraction.
talents:
Body Control:  New, STR, Simple Action, 0 Strain, uses Step for unarmed Damage tests with one-handed weapon size limit bonus.
Gauntlet Weaving / Thread Weaving:  Existing.
Deliberate Assault:  New, Rank Step, Free Action, 1 Strain, lowers Initiative to gain equal bonus up to Rank on next attack against higher Initiative foe.
Studied Counter:  New, PER, Simple Action, 1 Strain, +2 per success to next Attack/Damage test against target that took Standard Action.
Patient Resilience:  New, Rank Step, Free Action, 2 Strain, gains armor/attack bonuses when Initiative is lower than rank.
Focused Strike:  New, WIL, Free Action, 1 Strain, adds Step to Damage test result.
Pattern Infusion & Pattern Manifestation:  New Discipline abilities.
Shatter Will:  New, WIL, Free Action, 2 Strain, -2 to target's Defenses per success.
lore: Sample Characters: Kelim Telaar, Omen the Upstart, Damarion the Dune Hammer, Roogeh Moonlow, Balmuth, Tenus, Wanderer. Associated Practices: Terrene (sensing surroundings through earth/elements), Flow (meditative communication between Gauntlets sharing contact with earth). Artisan Skills: Body Painting, Rune Carving. Mentioned as a martial Discipline favored in Vasgothia by wilderness and tribal groups like the Bear Striders (e.g., Vaskir Stormspeaker, a Seventh Circle Elementalist / Fourth Circle Gauntlet).

name: Shaman
identity: A standard spellcasting/magician Discipline centered on the magic of life, spirits, nature, spiritual guidance, herbalism, and healing arts. Focuses on maintaining relationships, partnerships, and bonds with beast spirits and natural entities as companions rather than servants. Serves as a master of rites (skallgar) among Vasgothian Barrite tribes. Important Attributes: Willpower, Charisma, Perception. Eligibility / Restrictions: No specific racial restrictions, but requires deep connection to nature and maintaining good relationships with spirits; bending spirits to will or abusing them causes a Discipline crisis. Source: Earthdawn Fourth Edition: The Adept's Journey: Mystic Paths, pages 167-178 (PDF pp. 167-178).
progression:
Circle progression (1-15):  Includes access to Shaman spells and talents.
First Circle (Novice):  Durability 3; Free Talents: Standard Matrix (x2); Discipline Talents: Awareness, Patterncraft, Thread Weaving (Shamanism), Spellcasting, Wilderness Survival; Novice Option choices: Animal Bond, Animal Training, Avoid Blow, Climbing, Creature Analysis, Enhance Animal Companion, Navigation, Standard Matrix, Stealthy Stride, Tracking. Spells: Alter Tracks, Animal Friendship, Badger Mettle, Cetacean Breathing, Hungry Like the Wolf, Pack Mule, Woodland Helpers.
Second Circle:  +1 Mystic Defense; Discipline Talent: Astral Sight. Spells: Bear's Sleep, Bleeding Edge, Hair Frenzy, Invoke Turtle Snap, Invoke Wolf Maim, Porcupine Quills, Tiger Roar.
Third Circle:  Karma: Spend Karma Point on test to Summon or interact with a spirit; Discipline Talent: Spirit Talk. Spells: Autumnal Bear, Creeping Viper, Crow's Affinity, Eagle's Bearing, Flash of Insight, Invigorate, Invoke Falcon Dive, Wake with the Sun.
Fourth Circle:  +1 Physical Defense; Discipline Talent: Danger Sense. Spells: Awaken, Bioluminescence, Invoke Hedgehog Nip, Mark of the Crane, Meerkat Estate, Octopus Snare, Share Senses.
Journeyman Talent Options (Circles 5-8):  Animal Companion Durability, Animal Talk, Anticipate Blow, Borrow Sense, Call Animal Companion, Enhanced Matrix, Safe Path, Spirit Mount, Steel Thought, Tenacious Weave.
Fifth Circle (Journeyman):  Free Talent Upgrade: One Standard Matrix upgraded to Enhanced Matrix; Ability: Pack Leadership (30-min ritual, mark Shamanism rank allies for 1 Blood Magic Damage each to affect all marked targets with Pack spells); Karma: Spend Karma Point for extra thread (Increased Effect) on Binding/Spirit spells; Discipline Talent: Summon (Beast Spirits). Spells: Bear's Might, Brightleaf, Darting Mongoose, Hulking Champion, Lion's Pride, Pelican Soar, Relax, Sparrow Raid.
Sixth Circle:  +2 Mystic Defense; Discipline Talent: Willforce. Spells: Diminutive Warrior, Invoke Rhinoceros Rush, Lifelight, Mark of the Bison, Personal Space, Rat's Trickery, Shrunken Foe, Sworn Protector.
Seventh Circle:  +1 Initiative Step; Discipline Talent: Lifesight. Spells: Cat's Victory, Invoke Mink Snap, Karmic Connection, Mark of the Tarrack, Soothing Atmosphere, They Grow Up so Fast, Wolf Pack.
Eighth Circle:  +3 Mystic Defense; Discipline Talent: Lion Heart. Spells: Dampen Karma, Guiding Visions, Hunger Pangs, Invoke Fox Skirmish, Search the Stars, Star-Crossed, Viper Fangs.
Warden Talent Options (Circles 9-12):  Armor Mount, Armored Matrix, Banish, Blood Share, Bloodhound Form, Dispel Magic, Eagle Eye, Hold Thread, Orbiting Spy, Tiger Spring.
Ninth Circle (Warden):  Spirit Pact (8-hour ritual, 1 Blood Magic Damage, grants extra power and +1 success when summoning Named spirits); Karma: Spend Karma Point on Recovery test; Discipline Talent: Summoning Circle. Spells: Claw Talisman, Cling to Life, Dietary Restriction, Improve Karma, Mold the Skin, Songbird.
Tenth Circle:  +2 Physical Defense, +1 Mystic Armor; Discipline Talent: Spirit Covenant. Spells: Imbue Spirits, Weather Change, Wild Boar, Wisent Vitality.
Eleventh Circle:  +1 Social Defense; Karma: Spend Karma Point for extra thread (Increased Range) on Pack/Spirit spells; Discipline Talent: Lion Spirit. Spells: Death Vow, Reattach Limb.
Twelfth Circle:  +4 Mystic Defense, +2 Initiative Steps; Discipline Talent: Concise Casting. Spells: Eternal Day, Wild Hunt.
Master Talent Options (Circles 13-15):  Animal Leadership, Chameleon, Echolocation, Effect Pattern, Netherwalk, Resist Pain, Shared Matrix, Unflinching Fortitude.
Thirteenth Circle (Master):  Spirit Fuse (8-hour ritual, +1 success on Binding/Spirit spells, imbue Spirit keyword for 1 Strain); +3 Physical Defense, Karma Step d8, +1 Recovery Test per day; Discipline Talent: Ancient Bonds. Spells: New Moon's Blessing, Restore Pattern.
Fourteenth Circle:  +5 Mystic Defense, +2 Mystic Armor; Discipline Talent: Soul Aegis. Spells: Council of Beasts, Regrowth.
Fifteenth Circle:  +2 Social Defense, +3 Initiative Steps; Discipline Talent: Spliced Weave. Spells: Delay Fate, Full Moon's Curse.
magicianRules:
Thread Weaving Talent:  Thread Weaving (Shamanism) / Spirit Weaving.
Spellcasting and Patterncraft:  Standard magician rules apply; uses Patterncraft and Spellcasting discipline talents.
Spell Category:  Shaman Spells / Shamanism (focused on spirits, nature, animal transformations, pack bonds).
Free Matrix Grants & Upgrades:  Starts with 2 Standard Matrices at 1st Circle (Standard, Enhanced, Armored, Split, Shared). Upgrades one to Enhanced Matrix at 5th Circle.
Starting Spells:  Standard starting spell allocation for magician Disciplines.
Grimoire / Special Rules:  Grimoires/pattern items used. Special keywords include Pack, Spirit, Binding, and Fate. Cannot bind/traffic with invertebrate spirits (invae are anathema). Respect toward spirits required for Spirit Pact. Requires Binding Secrets knack and Pact rules to summon Named spirits for binding spells. Improved spell knacks require Learn Improved Spells knack (via Patterncraft). Skilled in Craft Rune Tattoo at rank 5 Patterncraft.
advancement:
Initial Talent Allocation:  Novice discipline talents start at Rank 1. Initial Talent Ranks and advancement follow standard Legend Point costs and talent rank requirements.
Training & Initiation:  Requires initiation/training through teachers or spirit mentorship.
Half-Magic:  Recognize animals, tracks, abnormal animal behavior; Perception-based test to detect beast spirits within 30 yards (DN = spirit Mystic Defense). Trained in herbalism, setting bones, sewing up wounds, and curing diseases. Involves attuning with natural and beast spirits.
Karma Ritual:  Walk a circle, draw a square inside, sit in middle, summon beast spirit, groom/scratch it for 30 minutes.
Restrictions & Violations:  Must maintain respect toward spirits; breaking Spirit Pact requires atonement service. Must refrain from coercive/demanding behavior or Contests of Wills with pact spirits. Violations include harming or abusing bound/summoned spirits, which destroys implicit trust and reputation.
talents:
Ancient Bonds:  New, PER, Special Action, 1 Strain, casts Binding/Spirit spells through a spirit within range.
Spirit Covenant:  New, CHA, Standard Action, 2 Strain, assumes/absolves spirit pacts and bindings.
Craft Rune Tattoo:  Knack requiring Patterncraft 5, Shaman 5.
Existing / Magician Talents:  Animal Bond, Animal Leadership, Animal Possession, Animal Talk, Borrow Sense, Call Animal Companion, Claw Shape, Cold Purify, Dominate Beast, Lifesight, Plant Talk, Spirit Hold, Spirit Talk, Summon (Beast Spirits), Tracking, Wilderness Survival, World Pulse, Patterncraft, Spellcasting, Summoning Circle, Concise Casting, Spliced Weave, Soul Aegis, Thread Weaving (Shamanism).
lore: Associated with nature, wild spaces, and animal companions. Fulfills the role of priest/master of rites (skallgar) in Barrite tribes, interpreting dreams, conducting birth/death rituals, and applying tattoos/rune tattoos. Associated Spirits: Beast Spirits (Canine, Feline, Hoofed, Primate, Raptor, Rodent, Ursine). Sample Characters: Sunshadow (accompanied by Dawn, a large white wolf), Hawkclaw, Morningstar Deerskin, Rockwalker. Utilizes Binding Secrets with Named spirits such as Akela, Grey Brother, Mother Wolf, Hegy, Little Sister, Papa Bear, Chaachee, Mysa, Rama, Derf the Pygmy Hog, Ivanod, Mocca, Grace, Mao, Rudolf, Chil, Ignatz, Rann, Kaa Who Remembers, Nagaina, White Hood, Buzz, Crazy Eedy, Trample, The Jungle Lord, Looey, and Squeak. Artisan Skills: Dancing, Tattooing.
